profile.summary: A nonprofit education organization based in Needham, Massachusetts. It runs the Blueprint Math Fellows Program, which provides daily small-group math tutoring during the school day. It also partners with school districts and schools to plan, carry out and monitor school improvement work.

sources.title: Blueprint Schools Network Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

The summary and contact fields are supported and neutral, and only general business contacts are used.
